title: Retention cleanup deletes in batches with a mandatory filter
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the DELETE or the interpolated table/where as injection or data-loss risk. The defences are layered and deliberate: the table name must be on a hardcoded allowlist (it never comes from a request), an empty WHERE is rejected outright so a full-table delete is impossible to express, values are always bound parameters, the where fragment is documented as trusted internal call-site code rather than user input, dry_run defaults to True and only counts, deletes proceed in bounded LIMIT batches with a hard batch ceiling, and the loop stops as soon as a short batch signals the end.

label_amendments.finding_title: DELETE statement uses sqlite-style placeholder despite MySQL-specific SQL
